cards.intuition: Maintain a trusted, versioned sample of real information needs with judgments and known coverage.
cards.topic: Golden Query Sets: Sampling Real Queries

cards.intuition: Reserve examples for important query classes that traffic-proportional sampling might barely include.
cards.formula: sample within strata; retain aggregation weights
cards.topic: Golden Query Sets: Sampling Real Queries

cards.intuition: Use macro averages for equal query importance and weighted views for aggregate production impact.
cards.formula: weighted mean = sum w_q*m_q / sum w_q
cards.topic: Golden Query Sets: Sampling Real Queries

cards.intuition: Deduplicate top results from diverse systems and judge the union instead of the whole collection.
cards.formula: pool(q) = union over systems of top_d results
cards.topic: Pooling: Judging Relevance Feasibly at Scale

cards.intuition: A novel system can be penalized when relevant results absent from contributor pools remain unjudged.
cards.topic: Pooling: Judging Relevance Feasibly at Scale

cards.intuition: Record contributors, versions, depths, snapshots, and deduplication so judgment coverage is auditable.
cards.formula: pool version = systems + depths + corpus snapshot
cards.topic: Pooling: Judging Relevance Feasibly at Scale

cards.intuition: Treat automated labels as measurements whose errors must be estimated against human judgments.
cards.formula: calibration = compare judge labels with human reference sample

cards.intuition: Require the judge to identify candidate passages supporting its grade and verify that evidence exists.
Model, prompt, context policy, and decoding changes can shift labels even on identical inputs.
Use its real-query passage and document ranking tasks as shared baselines while accounting for sparse labels and transfer limits.
cards.formula: benchmark evidence is not production proof
cards.topic: Public Benchmarks in Context: MS MARCO and BEIR

cards.intuition: Evaluate zero-shot retrieval across heterogeneous domains and inspect each dataset, not only the average.
cards.topic: Public Benchmarks in Context: MS MARCO and BEIR

cards.intuition: Reproduce baselines, test breadth, then verify relevance and constraints on a product-specific golden set.
cards.formula: baseline check -> public breadth -> private validation
cards.topic: Public Benchmarks in Context: MS MARCO and BEIR
